definitions.control_run: the saved s2 run (--control-run): the trainer at a48cac796 with --planner-target-candidate on; a body sent the target candidate is sent, on the candidate's position and orientation numbers, 0.35 x the new command + 0.65 x the smoother's memory (under --smooth-source proposal, the running blend of every proposal since the last latch, LemLite._prev_mfa)
definitions.treated_run: the new run (--treated-run): the trainer at 46e0c8363 with --planner-target-candidate on and --planner-target-candidate-unblended on; the candidate is scored for every body before the selection with its own executed values on the fields it sets (x y z of the decoder's position rows, the quaternion of its turn rows) and, where chosen, sent with them instead of the blend
definitions.question: the effect of the repaired target-candidate POLICY: the candidate scored for every body before the selection and, where chosen, sent with its own executed position and orientation values instead of the 0.35/0.65 blend, with the real chooser. The chooser may pick different bodies in the two runs, so this does not separate the movement's mechanics from the changed selection (the overseer item 3)
definitions.model_step: one 50 ms model update: 5 physics steps of 10 ms, called a burst in the world records
definitions.command: the 26 body handles x 9 numbers sent to the body: position x y z (cm), orientation as 4 numbers (x y z w), radius, strength 0 to 1
definitions.target_pose: T: the stored pose of the selected memory target (goal_pose, the pose memory row of the goal ring index), the pose both runs' forecasts were scored against; positions in the arrays are cm / 200
definitions.hand_distance_cm: D: a wrist handle's (wrist_L or wrist_R) straight-line distance from the same handle of T, cm. start: the capture's physical.wrist_gap_cm.start (the pose at the decision of model step 496,250); predicted: the selected forecast pose (forecast_pose__selected_position_cm) against goal_pose x 200; measured: the capture's physical.wrist_gap_cm.end, the pose after the command's 5 bursts (250 ms). 0 cm = the wrist exactly at T's wrist; the start value is where the hand began; the ability line is 2.0 cm (see ability)
definitions.treated_minus_control_cm: the treated run's measured D minus the control run's, the same hand and the same saved decision: below 0 = the treated hand ended nearer T (nearer); above 0 = farther (a regression); 0 = equal
definitions.treated_minus_start_cm: the treated run's measured D minus D at the start: below 0 = the hand ended nearer T than it began; above 0 = farther
definitions.control_minus_start_cm: the control run's measured D minus D at the start, read as treated_minus_start_cm
definitions.counts: per group and over all 16 hands: nearer = hands whose difference is below 0, farther = above 0, equal = exactly 0, missing = a reading absent (a body without a valid target, or an endpoint not read); the four add up to the group's hands
definitions.median_and_maximum: over the group's hands with both readings: median_cm = the middle value (the mean of the two middle values for an even count); maximum_cm = the largest value, the worst regression when above 0 (when every hand ended nearer, it is the smallest improvement and reads below 0)
definitions.groups: per body, from target_candidate.selected in each run: common_selected = chosen in both runs; newly_selected = chosen in the treated run only; no_longer_selected = chosen in the control run only; neither = chosen in neither run; null = a run's selected list is absent
definitions.pose_error: the planner's units: mean over the 25 non-gaze handles and 3 axes of (cm / 1.80)^2, plus the same of (degrees / 11.0)^2; 0 = every handle at T, 1 = one 250 ms movement scale per axis away. start: the control capture's physical.pose_error.start (G2 compares it with the treated capture's); predicted: objective.physical.selected_forecast position + rotation, the command sent; measured: physical.pose_error.end, the pose after the 5 bursts
definitions.contacts: over the world records of model steps 496,250 to 496,254 (observer/world/b<body>/chunk_*.npz: one record per model step, taken at the last physics step of its burst, its contacts gathered over every physics step of the burst, so the five records cover the 250 ms of the held command). A contact is a pair of entities in contact (c_e: two entity codes of the entities list of the header the chunk names; an infant body part has kind 'self', the others are object, caregiver, floor, wall, art, ceiling or static), c_row the record it belongs to, c_fmax its largest normal force over the burst's physics steps, N. Only pairs with an infant part count (a box resting on the floor does not); the partner is the other entity, or kind 'self' when both are infant parts (the infant touching itself). records_with_non_floor_contact = how many of the 5 records hold a contact whose partner is not the floor (0 to 5); non_floor_peak_force_n = the largest c_fmax among those contacts (0 N = no such contact; for scale, weight_n = the infant's weight from the header, mass x 9.81 m/s^2); records_with_contact_other_than_floor_or_self and contact_other_than_floor_or_self_peak_force_n = the same two readings without the infant touching itself (partner kind neither floor nor self: an object, the caregiver, a wall, the art or the ceiling); by_partner_kind gives every partner kind, the floor and self included, with its record count and peak force. An absent record, a chunk without c_row, c_e or c_fmax, or an unreadable header makes those five null with the reason in missing, never zero; the two _among_read counts count the records that were read
definitions.falls: over the same records, from the root's free joint qpos[0:7] (x y z in m, orientation w x y z), converted with the header's qpos_quantum (the recorder stores whole multiples of 1e-6 m and 1e-7); the reference is the first record (model step 496,250, after the hold's first burst). root_height_drop_cm = (the first record's z - this record's z) x 100: 0 = the same height, above 0 = lower; beyond_drop_line = more than 2.0 cm. root_tilt_change_deg = the angle between the world's up direction seen from the root at the first record and at this record (R(q)^T (0, 0, 1)): 0 = the same tilt, 90 = a quarter turn such as from the back onto a side, 180 = upside down; turning about the vertical axis does not count; beyond_tilt_line = more than 60 degrees. It stands for the trunk's roll: the project's calibrated roll (env body_orientation) reads the chest's rotation, which the world record holds only through forward kinematics, so this tilt of the root counts rolling and pitching alike. fall = true when a record is beyond either line, false when all 5 records were read and none is, null otherwise; a record is not read when it, its qpos or the header's quantum is absent, or the header does not show qpos[0:7] as the root's free joint
definitions.final_outputs: per output and body, whether the two runs hold the same value (arrays bit for bit, record fields exactly), in three tables: planner_output (the command planned, sent and executed, plan0, the hand joint goal, the selected forecast, the depth-one forecast and the selection's record fields), chosen_set (target_candidate.selected and selected_source, the array of the selected bodies) and candidate_evaluation (the candidate's forecast, goal, effort, order, executed offsets and its rejection reason). GATED by G3 for the neither bodies only (target_candidate.selected false in both runs: both runs sent them the ordinary winner through the same blended transform): every DECISION_FIELDS path (same_value) and every DECISION_ARRAYS array (bit for bit) of planner_output; the neither bodies' goal_distance.forecast_depth1, search_selected and chosen_set entries are reported here and expected equal by the code. Reported, not gated: for a common_selected body the treated run sent the candidate unblended, so its command and forecast differ by design; for newly_selected and no_longer_selected bodies the runs sent different commands; the candidate's evaluation differs in every body by design, the treated run scoring it unblended
definitions.fall_reference: The state before the command's first burst: each run's world records begin with model step 496,250, the record taken after that burst, so the fall reference is that record. A drop or tilt inside that first burst is not counted; D at the start is the pose at the decision, before that burst
definitions.sent_command_equal: per body: command.sent_sha (SHA-256, first 16 hex, of the body's command sent at the latch) equal in both runs
definitions.offered: the candidate was built from a valid stored target and its evaluation is finite
